posts.cooked:
I wanted to ask for some guidance regarding the OPPE for System Commands. I’ve heard that scoring well in this component can be a bit challenging, so I wanted to know how we can prepare effectively for it.

If anyone could share useful resources, reference materials, or preparation tips that helped them, it would be really helpful.
Any suggestions on what topics to focus on or how to practice system commands properly would also be appreciated.

Thank you in advance for your support!

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
The more you practice the better you get. The reason why everyone feels OPPE is tough because with 1 week of practice you cannot pass it as there are many commands with lots of options (flag). The best way to score well is regular practice.

Sharing the below as a fellow student -

Key things to practice personal experience but not limited to the below -

  • Regex (most important)
  • File manipulation
  • Reading from a file
  • Search patterns (Grep)
  • Sed
  • Awk
  • sort, uniq, tr, cut etc.
  • ps, sleep, kill, variables etc.
  • using mathematical expressions in bash scripts, bc calculator, etc.
  • command line utilities such as find
    (not an exhaustive list)

You can practice at

  • hackerank if you want command-wise practice → link
  • vm has many questions such as q-grep, practice, oppe etc

This doesn’t mean that you should not study from Week 1-9. You should study & practice all the concepts!

Note:- I am not endorsing any platform. I simply used to practice for my oppe as well and found it useful that’s why I am sharing this.

How I used to practice?

Create a file of your interest preferably a csv (eg if you are interested in sports let say then get 20-40 lines csv file with 6-9 columns) try to manipulate it in different way → maybe sorting, unique entries, deleting line, computing average, maxmium value, minimum etc. That way you’ll get a good grasp of concepts.

Practice well you’ll do good don’t worry!

Thanks & Regards,
Swati Jain

Thanks a lot , this is the best explanation I’ve got . I’ll surely follow whatever you have told and will come back to tell you how it all went .
Well again , thank you

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Here is the list of commands that the course covers - Summary - Google Drive

Greetings Mam , I hope you are doing good .

I did follow the pattern you stated but maybe my practice wasn’t enough , I was only able to solve 1 question correctly and as for the other one only some test cases were passed . I couldn’t build the logic and went completely blank .

Is there any other way to prepare for re-oppe ? Please guide mam , I heard the re-oppe is going to be more difficult .

Warm Regards ,
Madhvi

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Hello Madhvi,

I am good & hope you are too.

The best idea is to check where you went wrong? Was it just exam fear? Or you didn’t grasp some concepts? Which ones exactly? Work upon those!

The key is to identify “where you failed”
syntax? practice more - see the solution to a question and type it without seeing it once that way you remember it!
logic? break a complex problem into smaller parts and build upon it
file manipulation? practice those!

If you practice in enough you will do good!

I mentioned the commands that does not mean you should know only those but also have a grasp the concepts from Week 1-9

Thanks & Regards,
Swati Jain
